goal:
T65 — Arena prompt bar (owner: the real Arena has a prompt input at the bottom; the comparison is on what the
user asks for). Web only; API from T64: POST /v1/arena/prompt {prompt (1..2000 chars), feedback "critic"|"heldout",
single_apply "tolerant"|"strict"} -> 202 {arena_id}; GET /v1/arena/{id} returns mode "prompt", prompt, manifest
{acceptance_count, acceptance_dropped, acceptance_hash, prompt_hash, judge, lanes...}, judge_cost_cents, lanes (with
preview_html / preview_source / heldout scores on the acceptance suite) and verdict (winner may be "unscorable").
1. apps/web/lib/arenaStatus.ts: promptArenaView(doc) -> null unless doc.mode === "prompt"; else {prompt,
   acceptanceCount (manifest.acceptance_count or 0), dropped (manifest.acceptance_dropped or 0), scorable (null while
   the arena is not finished; true only when finished with acceptanceCount >= 3 and winner !== "unscorable"),
   judgeCost ("N¢" from judge_cost_cents or "—"), judge (manifest.judge or ""), winner (verdict.winner only when
   finished and scorable and it is evoforge|single|tie, else null)}. Keep Codex's truth rules for the lanes.
2. apps/web/lib/api.ts: postPromptArena(prompt, feedback = "critic", single_apply = "tolerant").
3. apps/web/components/PromptBar.tsx: a bar fixed (or sticky) at the bottom of the Arena page: <textarea
   maxLength={2000}> with a character counter and placeholder, feedback select (critic default), equal-tools note,
   Start button enabled only when process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_EVO_OPERATOR_CONTROLS === "1" (window.confirm with the cost
   warning first; otherwise an operator-only note); on 202 it hands the arena_id to the page.
4. apps/web/app/[locale]/arena/page.tsx: render PromptBar at the bottom; when the shown arena is a prompt arena show
   promptArenaView above the lanes (the prompt, "N acceptance tests written by an independent judge before either side
   ran (K dropped as already passing)", unscorable warning, judge cost apart from the lanes' costs) and the two lanes'
   SandboxedPreview as today. The bottom bar must not cover the content (add bottom padding).
5. i18n (en + ko) keys: prompt-placeholder, prompt-start, prompt-unscorable, prompt-judge-cost (plus any you add).
Keep tsc green and every web-structure test green. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t65.py.
